dedupe_keys.name: trees in green spaces of the city of buenos aires buenos aires data

description: This dataset on the Buenos Aires Data open data portal, published by the green spaces directorate of the city's Ministry of Environment and Public Space, gives geolocated information on the trees in the city's green spaces: gardens, parks, recreational yards, squares, small squares, planted medians and sports grounds. The dataset page says the information corresponds to the census of street trees carried out in 2011. It can be downloaded as CSV, as a zipped shapefile and as an XLSX file, each with a preview and a history of earlier versions, and the portal runs on CKAN with an API. The licence is CC BY 2.5 Argentina, and access is free. Caveats: the page states an annual update frequency, but the census it cites dates from 2011, so the current state of the trees may differ, and the page is in Spanish. Coverage is the City of Buenos Aires. It supports urban heat, stormwater and green infrastructure analysis, such as canopy planning and storm damage risk to streets and power lines from falling trees; related records are the Copenhagen street trees and the Hong Kong tree register.
